scope: All supported Z8 pixel-shift output modes in the native merger

interface.output_set: nxc merge <ordered NEF files> --outputs N --output-directory NEW_DIRECTORY
interface.manifest: Capture paths/hashes/numbers, each output's original zero-based input indices, NEFX hashes, dimensions, sample counts, correction mode and limitations.
interface.grouping: Consecutive equal-sized groups except 32-to-four, which pairs four-frame groups at offsets 0/16, 4/20, 8/24 and 12/28.
interface.metadata: Each output inherits its group's first source. Marker 0x0e2d retains source capture mode and records per-output input count separately.

publication.platform: Linux with libc renameat2 and filesystem RENAME_NOREPLACE support
publication.algorithm: Write/verify outputs privately, validate the complete original sequence and source hashes, fsync manifest and staging directory, publish with one no-replace rename, then fsync the destination parent directory.
publication.existing_destination: Rejected even when the destination is an empty directory or dangling symlink, including a concurrent creation.
publication.failure: Decode, metadata, write, verification, source mutation and cancellation failures leave no partial output set at the requested destination.
publication.durability_limit: Successful publication now synchronizes the destination parent. Parent-sync failure or interruption preserves the published result and returns a warning. Actual power-loss recovery is not experimentally established.

parent_sync_regression.fault_tests: File and directory publication order, OSError and KeyboardInterrupt during parent sync, descriptor closure, and successful batch report with retained outputs on sync failure.

saved_vendor_matrix.source_kind: Independently varying synthetic packed14 frames with synthetic capture identity. Sparse repair selectors are zero and chromatic correction is disabled.

single_file_regression.scope: Existing single-file merge with sparse repair and chromatic correction remains equal to saved Nikon output.

live_corrected_vendor_comparison.coverage: All five multiple-output combinations at ISO 3200 and 3201 with nonzero sparse selectors and radial correction enabled. Additional 16-to-four cases exercise signed centers and all six nonzero polynomial coefficients.
live_corrected_vendor_comparison.reference: Fresh execution of the pinned PixelShiftCombine.dll through Wine as an external research oracle; production merger remains native.
